task: What is the name of the star system closest to the Solar System, and what are the discovered planets in it?
answer:
FINAL: The closest star system to the Solar System is Alpha Centauri, comprising Alpha Centauri A, Alpha Centauri B, and Proxima Centauri. Its confirmed planets are Proxima Centauri b and Proxima Centauri d, both orbiting Proxima Centauri. Proxima Centauri c is a reported candidate, as is Alpha Centauri A b; Alpha Centauri B b has been refuted.

Evidence (checked 27 October 2026): NASA identifies Alpha Centauri as our nearest neighboring system, with Proxima Centauri about 4.25 light-years away: https://science.nasa.gov/exoplanets/other-stars-other-worlds/our-nearest-celestial-neighbor-an-exotic-3-star-system/
NASA’s Exoplanet Archive lists b and d as “Confirmed Planet,” c and Alpha Centauri A b as “Candidate Planet,” and Alpha Centauri B b as “False Positive Planet”: https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/overview/proxima%20centauri%20c
Screenshot: final.png shows the system name and the archive’s discovery/status table.
